attchmntText: Outcome of Board Meeting held today, on November 12, 2026 and announcements pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
voiceSummary: Murudeshwar Ceramics Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors K.G. Rao & Co. The meeting commenced at 11:30 A.M. and concluded at 12:35 P.M. The company filed this disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The financial statements were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard 34. The document includes segment-wise revenue, profit before tax, and total comprehensive income figures for the specified periods.
